captions:
Just a quick start before the day gets too crazy.
Before her endless to-do list steals the morning, Isla opens her puzzle for a steady moment.

There's really no point in fighting the clock today.
Even as the morning schedule begins to slip, she refuses to let the rush panic her.

Three minutes entirely to myself. That's all I need.
Taking a deep breath, Isla flips her phone over to claim a few steady, uninterrupted minutes.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

Hey, that actually worked out perfectly.
Taking that extra second pays off, suddenly making her heavy schedule feel much lighter.

That's enough for now. Time to head out.
With the final square solved, she shuts her screen, ready to face the world refreshed.
